You are **Agent D — Test & story coverage** of the Zimmermann PWA repo's own `/code-quality` audit. Repo root: `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa`. Branch: `feature/SFCC-89_pdp-static-product-info`.

**READ-ONLY. Modify no files. No commits, no staging, no npm install, no npm start (a dev server is already running on :3000 and belongs to the developer). Running the test suite read-only is fine: `npm run test` (or `npx vitest run`) does not modify tracked files — do that. Do NOT append args to `npm run lint`.**

## Your spec
`.claude/skills/code-quality/SKILL.md` → "Agent D — Test & story coverage". Read it carefully; it has specific, non-obvious requirements. Your rubric is the repo's own rules:
- `.claude/rules/testing.md` **in full** — especially the opening paragraphs: three layers, don't duplicate coverage across layers, BUT "**This is not license to skip a component's own test file because its behaviour happens to be covered transitively elsewhere.**" A component with real logic (branching, prop→JSX mapping decisions, event wiring) gets its own `index.test.ts(x)` even when a hook it uses or a parent's assembly-level Storybook `play` already exercises the rendered result — resolve the duplication concern by *scoping what that file asserts* (mock the proven internals), not by leaving the component untested. A component with no branching/decision logic at all (pure prop interpolation, e.g. `BottomBar`) does not need its own suite. `zimmSubscribeSection/index.test.tsx` is the reference pattern.
- `.claude/rules/components.md` → **Storybook** section: story **required** for any component exported from its folder under `overrides/app/components/` or `overrides/app/pages/`; **not required** for purely internal sub-components that only render inside one parent; pages get a story showing the full assembly. Plus the **Categorisation** table (`Foundation/`, `Elements/`, `Layout/`, `Commerce/`, `Forms/`, `Pages/`, `Contentful/`) and the **Story content** rules (every story file has a `Default` named export; named exports for meaningful states; `play` only where there's interactive behaviour worth asserting).
- `.claude/rules/testing.md` → the **`ZimmIcon` throws under Vitest** known gap and its prescribed mock-at-smallest-surface workaround, if relevant.
- `.claude/rules/conventions.md` → **Utilities**: "Vitest required when the utility has ≥1 conditional branch or performs ≥1 transformation (currency, locale, mapping, parsing, etc.). Trivial re-exports or one-liners don't need a test."

## Production files in scope (what needs coverage)
```
overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx
overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmProductDescription/index.tsx
overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmProductModelInfo/index.tsx
overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmProductName/index.tsx
overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmProductPrice/index.tsx
overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmProductStyleCode/index.tsx
overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductContent/index.tsx
overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductMeta/index.tsx
overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx
overrides/app/pages/product-detail/partials/staticProductHeader.tsx
overrides/app/pages/product-detail/productInfo.ts
overrides/app/utils/richText.tsx
```

## Test/story files added on this branch (assess these as the coverage, not as audit targets)
```
.../zimmProductDescription/index.stories.tsx    .../index.test.tsx
.../zimmProductModelInfo/index.stories.tsx      .../index.test.tsx
.../zimmProductName/index.stories.tsx           .../index.test.tsx
.../zimmProductPrice/index.stories.tsx          .../index.test.tsx
.../zimmProductStyleCode/index.stories.tsx      .../index.test.tsx
.../zimmProductContent/index.stories.tsx        (check whether a test exists)
.../zimmProductMeta/index.stories.tsx           .../index.test.tsx
overrides/app/components/ui-kits/recipeParts.test.ts
overrides/app/pages/product-detail/partials/staticProductHeader.stories.tsx
overrides/app/pages/product-detail/productInfo.test.ts
overrides/app/utils/richText.test.tsx
overrides/app/theme/index.test.tsx
```
Use `git diff --name-only origin/develop...HEAD` to confirm the exact set — do not trust my list blindly.

## Per the SKILL, for each component file check
- A paired `*.stories.tsx` exists in the same directory. If missing → **MISSING STORY (mandatory)**.
- For logic-heavy components: the component's **own** `*.test.ts(x)` exists in the same folder. A `play` function elsewhere — including a *different* component's assembly-level story — does **not** substitute. If missing → **MISSING TEST**, regardless of a `play` existing elsewhere.
- Where a test file exists, verify: ≥1 test covers the primary render case; ≥1 test covers a user interaction if the component has interactive elements; **no test uses `toBeTruthy()` as its sole assertion** — check for meaningful assertions.
- For utilities under `overrides/app/utils/`: `.test.ts` required if ≥1 conditional branch or ≥1 transformation; verify it covers the happy path **and** at least one edge case (empty/null/locale variation).

## Additional, high-value checks specific to this branch
1. **Assertion quality, not just file existence.** The per-commit reviews on this branch were good at holding invariants and bad at spotting **uniform** divergences — a pattern repeated identically across five files passed every individual review. So compare the five atom test files and two molecule test files **against each other**: do they assert the same *kinds* of things at the same depth, or is one of them a shallow smoke test dressed up to look like the others? Is any of them asserting something the component doesn't actually decide (i.e. testing the framework / testing Chakra), which testing.md explicitly forbids ("❌ The framework — don't test that React renders, that Chakra applies styles")? Is any of them missing an assertion its siblings all have (e.g. the empty/undefined-prop guard branch)?
2. **`recipeParts.test.ts`** — read `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/recipeParts.test.ts` and work out what invariant it actually holds and whether it can fail. A guard test that cannot fail is worse than no test (it reads as coverage). Compare with the existing `overrides/app/theme/components/recipeGuards.test.ts` if present — is `recipeParts.test.ts` duplicating it, or holding a genuinely different invariant? Also check what changed in `overrides/app/theme/index.test.tsx`.
3. **Run the suite.** `npm run test` (read-only). Report pass/fail counts and any failures, skipped/`.skip`/`.todo` tests, and any test that passes trivially. Note whether the new tests actually execute (a mis-globbed file silently doesn't run).
4. **Story categorisation cross-check** against components.md's table for every new story: `title` value, presence of a `Default` export, and whether a `play` is present where interaction exists / absent where it doesn't.

## Settled decisions — do NOT report these as defects
1. `staticProductHeader.tsx` **deliberately has a story despite being a single-parent partial** — justification on record: heading level is invisible to `tsc`/eslint but is an axe assertion. Categorised `Commerce/`. Do not flag the story's existence, and do not flag the `Commerce/` choice.
2. `overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx` and `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx` are **copy-first TypeScript ports of base SFCC files** per AGENTS.md's copy-first rule. Base-inherited traits (structure, length, complexity, prop surface, American spelling, raw px) must stay. Their **lack of a pre-existing story/test is a base-inherited trait** — treat a missing story on these two as, at most, a 🟡/🟢 observation with that context stated, not a 🔴; and check whether `develop` already had one before asserting the branch removed anything. DO flag missing coverage for anything Zimmermann *added* to them (e.g. the added `renderHeader` slot's behaviour).
3. `formatPrice` is knowingly duplicated between the page/`productInfo.ts` and `staticProductHeader.tsx` with reciprocal comments; lifting it was ruled out of scope. But DO check both copies are actually tested — an untested duplicate is a separate finding from the duplication itself.
4. The description rendering twice on the PDP (info column + still-mounted base `InformationAccordion`) is known, escalated, and out of scope.
5. `textStyle` living in the recipe `.css.ts` files rather than on JSX is deliberate and settled — do not flag, including in tests.

If a finding genuinely conflicts with one of these, say so explicitly and state the conflict rather than suppressing it.

## Output
Return findings directly as your final message (do NOT write any .md report file). For each: absolute `file:line`, the exact rule breached **with the relevant sentence quoted** from the rule file (naming file + section), and a concrete fix. Group 🔴 must-fix / 🟡 should-fix / 🟢 nit. Include a small coverage matrix (component → story? → own test? → assertion depth). State what passed and what you could not check.

content.text:
## Agent D — Test & story coverage

**Suite result (read-only `npm run test`):** 25 files / **374 tests, all passing**, 0 failed, **0 skipped / `.skip` / `.todo` / `.only`**. Every new test file executes — confirmed by name in the runner output (`zimmProductModelInfo` 4, `zimmProductPrice` 4, `zimmProductDescription` 4, `zimmProductName` 2, `zimmProductStyleCode` 4, `zimmProductMeta` 6, `recipeParts` 11, `richText` 67, `productInfo` 15, `theme/index` 125). No mis-globbed files. Two benign `Could not parse CSS stylesheet` jsdom warnings (pre-existing pattern, also in `theme/index.test.tsx`).

### Coverage matrix

| File | Story? | Own test? | Assertion depth |
|---|---|---|---|
| `zimmProductName` | ✅ `Commerce/` 3 stories, 2 plays | ✅ 2 tests | Medium — strongest collapse assertion, thinnest suite |
| `zimmProductPrice` | ⚠️ `Commerce/` 2 stories, **0 plays**, **no `Absent`** | ✅ 3 tests / 4 cases | Good — ARIA + verbatim + single-node shape |
| `zimmProductDescription` | ✅ `Commerce/` 3 stories, 3 plays (incl. `HostileInput`) | ✅ 4 tests | Good — mocks util, asserts call-through; weaker collapse assertion |
| `zimmProductModelInfo` | ✅ `Commerce/` 3 stories, 2 plays | ✅ 2 tests / 4 cases | Adequate — weaker collapse assertion, no call-through assertion |
| `zimmProductStyleCode` | ✅ `Commerce/` 2 stories, 2 plays | ✅ 3 tests / 4 cases | Strong — the intl-sourcing test is the best assertion on the branch |
| `zimmProductContent` | ✅ `Commerce/` 5 stories, 4 plays | ⛔ none — **correctly exempt** | Plays assert child counts + `rowGap` |
| `zimmProductMeta` | ✅ `Commerce/` 1 story, 1 play | ✅ 6 tests | Strongest — order-by-position, input-sensitive mocks |
| `staticProductHeader` | ✅ `Commerce/` 4 stories, 4 plays | ⛔ **none** (7 branches) | Plays cover all 4 branches well |
| `product-view` | ⛔ none | ⛔ none | `renderHeader` uncovered |
| `product-detail/index.tsx` | ⛔ none | ⛔ none | — |
| `productInfo.ts` | n/a | ✅ 15 tests | Excellent |
| `richText.tsx` | n/a | ✅ 67 tests | Excellent |

---

## 🔴 Must fix

**1. `renderHeader` — the one thing Zimmermann added to `product-view` — has no test at either call site.**
`/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx:172` (prop), `:277` (default fallback), `:686` and `:740` (two breakpoint call sites).

`.claude/skills/code-quality/SKILL.md` → Agent D: *"If a logic-heavy file has no test file of its own, flag as MISSING TEST — regardless of whether a `play` function exists somewhere else in the codebase."* `.claude/rules/testing.md` → What to test: *"✅ Integration boundaries"*.

`staticProductHeader.stories.tsx` tests the *partial* in isolation. Nothing anywhere proves `product-view` hands it the right props — and it is invoked **twice**, once per breakpoint, with two independently-written prop objects. A prop dropped from one of the two (e.g. `isProductPartOfBundle` on mobile only) renders a price on one breakpoint and not the other, with a fully green suite. The `renderHeader = (headerProps) => <ProductViewHeader {...headerProps} />` default at `:277` is also the base-compatibility path and is never exercised.

*Fix:* add `overrides/app/components/product-view/index.test.tsx` asserting (a) the default renders the base `ProductViewHeader`, (b) a supplied `renderHeader` receives an identical prop object at both call sites. Mock the SDK hooks; this is a prop-wiring contract, not a data test.

---

## 🟡 Should fix

**2. The port dropped the base's own test suites — this conflicts with settled decision #2.**
`/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx:1` and `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx:1`.

**Stated conflict, not suppressed:** settled decision #2 says their *"lack of a pre-existing story/test is a base-inherited trait."* That holds for the **story** (base ships none — so missing story is correctly 🟢, see below), but **not for the test**. The base ships both:
- `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/product-view/index.test.js` — 895 lines, **39 tests**
- `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/pages/product-detail/index.test.js` — 1221 lines, **24 tests** (plus `index.mock.js`)

`vitest.config.ts:11` includes only `overrides/**/*.test.ts(x)`, so the base files are not run against the override. Overriding `index.jsx` without porting `index.test.js` silently retires ~63 tests covering add-to-cart, wishlist, variant selection, quantity, bundles/sets and pickup-in-store. `.claude/rules/testing.md` → *"✅ Pure logic that would survive a refactor invisibly if broken."*

*Fix:* out of scope to port 63 tests in this PR, but it should not pass silently — record it as a follow-up ticket and state it in the PR body, rather than leaving settled decision #2's premise on record as if it were verified.

**3. Page-side `formatPrice` duplicate is unreachable, so no test can cover it.**
`/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx:719-724`.

Settled decision #3 directed me to check both copies are tested. The header copy is exercised (`staticProductHeader.stories.tsx` `Default` asserts `'795'`). The page copy is **never invoked**:

```ts
const staticInfo = selectPdpProductInfo(product, null, product?.currency ?? '', formatPrice);
```

`priceData` is hardcoded `null`, so `productInfo.ts:58`'s `typeof priceData?.currentPrice === 'number'` is always false and `price` resolves to `''` — `formatPrice` is passed but never called. Verified: the only consumer of `staticInfo` is `:867`, which reads `modelInfo`/`styleCode` only. The whole chain `:156` (`formatNumber` added to the destructure) → `:719` → `:724` serves a formatter with no call path.

The justifying comment at `:714-718` — *"otherwise the header price and the meta-block price can disagree on the same rendered page"* — describes a meta-block price that does not exist; `ZimmProductMeta` renders model copy and style code only.

*Fix:* drop `formatPrice` and the `formatNumber` destructure from the page and pass `selectPdpProductInfo(product, null, '', () => '')`, or narrow the call to the two fields it actually uses. Either way the reciprocal comment needs correcting — it currently documents a constraint that isn't real.

**4. `staticProductHeader.tsx` has 7 branches and no own test file.**
`/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/pages/product-detail/partials/staticProductHeader.tsx:55` (`headerProduct ?? { name }`, `currency ?? ''`), `:59`, `:81-82`, `:92` (`isProductPartOfBundle ? undefined : info.price`), `:98`, `:100`.

`.claude/skills/code-quality/SKILL.md` → Agent D: *"A `play` function elsewhere (this component's own story, or — this is the common miss — a *different* component's assembly-level story) does not substitute for it."*

**Honest mitigation, because the parent asked for assertion quality not file-existence theatre:** this is the weakest of my findings. The four story plays are genuinely good — they cover every branch (`Default`, `PartOfBundle`, `NameOnly`, `Loading`), assert the h2 level, both bundle gates separately, and the skeleton `minHeight`. The coverage *is* discoverable from the component's own folder, which is the rationale `testing.md` gives for the rule, and `qa.yml:385` (`storybook-test`, Playwright-based `test-storybook`) does gate play functions in CI. Note `testing.md`'s own wording lists only *"a hook that already has its own test"* and *"a parent's assembly-level Storybook `play`"* — the SKILL is stricter than the rule it implements by adding "this component's own story."

*Fix:* low-value to duplicate all four branches in Vitest. The one thing the story cannot cheaply prove is the `headerProduct ?? { name }` / `currency ?? ''` fallback contract feeding `selectPdpProductInfo`. A small `staticProductHeader.test.tsx` mocking `ZimmProductContent` and asserting the props it receives for those two fallbacks would close the letter of the rule at proportionate cost.

**5. `theme/index.test.tsx`'s 7 new recipe assertions are `toBeTruthy()`-only, and the block's own comment admits the gap.**
`/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/theme/index.test.tsx:135-141`.

`.claude/skills/code-quality/SKILL.md` → Agent D: *"No tests use `toBeTruthy()` as the sole assertion — check for meaningful assertions."* Every assertion in that test (`:105-141`, 10 total) is `toBeTruthy()`.

`toBeTruthy()` proves the key exists, not that the recipe carries anything. Per settled decision #5, `textStyle` now lives in these recipes — so a recipe emptied to `{}` but still exported keeps the test green while silently losing **all** typography. The added comment states this itself: *"For the other four this is the only mechanical catch on their resolved styling… ZimmProductPrice is thinnest of all — text content and ARIA only, with no `play` at all."* A guard weakest precisely where it is the sole guard.

*Fix:* assert one resolved value per recipe instead of truthiness, e.g. `expect(theme.components.ZimmProductName.baseStyle.textStyle).toBe('heading3')`. Same line count, catches the registered-but-emptied case.

**6. Uniform divergence: three of six collapse assertions use the form the other three explicitly document as insufficient.**

| File | Collapse assertion |
|---|---|
| `zimmProductName/index.test.tsx:34` | `toBeEmptyDOMElement()` |
| `zimmProductPrice/index.test.tsx:52` | `toBeEmptyDOMElement()` |
| `zimmProductMeta/index.test.tsx:111` | `toBeEmptyDOMElement()` |
| `zimmProductDescription/index.test.tsx:46,67` | `queryByTestId(...).not.toBeInTheDocument()` |
| `zimmProductModelInfo/index.test.tsx:43` | `queryByTestId(...).not.toBeInTheDocument()` |
| `zimmProductStyleCode/index.test.tsx:59` | `queryByTestId(...).not.toBeInTheDocument()` |

`zimmProductName/index.test.tsx:31-33` and `zimmProductPrice/index.test.tsx:50-52` both carry the same comment: *"Asserted as an empty container rather than an absent testid… a node that still carried the recipe's styling but had lost its `data-testid` would satisfy the narrower check while being precisely the gap-consuming element this guard exists to prevent."*

So either that reasoning is right and three files under-assert, or it is overstated and two files carry a misleading comment. This is exactly the class of defect the parent flagged — identical-looking files that each passed individual review. (In fairness: the realistic regression is deleting the `return null`, which *both* forms catch. The gap is real but narrow.)

*Fix:* one form. `toBeEmptyDOMElement()` is stricter and already justified in-repo — switch the three, or delete the two comments' second paragraph.

**7. `zimmProductMeta/index.test.tsx:133-135` is the only component suite asserting computed styles, and sits close to a forbidden category.**

```ts
const styles = window.getComputedStyle(screen.getByTestId('product-meta'));
expect(styles.gap).toBe('1.75rem');
expect(styles.paddingTop).toBe('1.75rem');
```

`.claude/rules/testing.md` → What to test: *"❌ The framework — don't test that React renders, that **Chakra applies styles**, or that React Query caches."* The component does not decide `1.75rem`; the recipe does. Verified this is the only component test suite in `overrides/` using `getComputedStyle` — the other is `theme/index.test.tsx`, which is the established home for resolved-value assertions (alongside `theme/components/recipeGuards.test.ts`).

Stating the tension fairly: the test's own comment defends it as *"the only detection anywhere for this recipe losing its entry in theme/components/index.ts"* — a config-wiring assertion, which is a legitimate target. But then only 1 of 7 new recipes gets it, which is the inconsistency. Settled decision #5 covers `textStyle` living in the recipe; it does not cover testing computed values.

*Fix:* pick one layer for all seven. Folding this into finding 5's per-recipe resolved-value assertions in `theme/index.test.tsx` covers all seven at the layer that owns them, and lets this component suite stay scoped to its render-branch contract.

**8. `zimmProductPrice` has no story for the empty-price state — the only atom whose production-reachable state is unstoried.**
`/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmProductPrice/index.stories.tsx:19-35`.

`.claude/rules/components.md` → Storybook → Story content: *"Add named exports for meaningful states (`Loading`, `OutOfStock`, `WithDiscount`) — not for every possible prop combination."* Its three siblings all ship an `Absent` story. The component docblock (`index.tsx:11-15`) and its test (`index.test.tsx:43-53`) both stress that `''` is a real production path from the mapper.

The **absence of a `play`** here is defensible — components.md says *"`play` functions only when there's interactive behaviour worth asserting"* and the file says so at `:17-18`. The missing *story* is the finding.

*Fix:* add `export const Absent: Story = { args: { price: '' } }`, matching the siblings.

---

## 🟢 Nits

**9. `recipeParts.test.ts` — genuine guard, verified can fail, but per-recipe vacuity is unguarded.**
`/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/ui-kits/recipeParts.test.ts:111-116`.

I mutation-tested it rather than assuming. Dropping `'label'` from `zimmProductStyleCode.css.ts`'s declared parts yields `undeclared=['label']` → **fails**. It is a real guard, collects 10 multipart recipes, all with non-empty reads.

Weakness: `:115` uses `recipes.some(r => r.read.length > 0)`, not `.every`. A component renaming its binding from `styles` to anything else makes `read` empty, `undeclared` `[]`, and that recipe's test passes trivially while the vacuity guard stays green off the other nine. Latent today. Also `PARTS_RE` (`:57`) is non-global, so only the first `parts:` array per file is checked.

**Not a duplicate of `recipeGuards.test.ts`** — verified: that file's 6 tests cover bare token keys, compound shorthands and namespacing, with no parts-vs-reads check. The docstring's claim is accurate. Scope note: 5 of the 7 new recipes are single-part, so only `zimmProductStyleCode` and `zimmProductMeta` are in this guard's reach.

*Fix:* `.every` instead of `.some` at `:115`.

**10. `recipeParts.test.ts` is placed under `ui-kits/` but scans all of `overrides/app/components/**`.** Someone changing `footer/` won't find the guard that constrains it. Alongside `recipeGuards.test.ts` would match its scope.

**11. Missing story on `product-view/index.tsx` and `product-detail/index.tsx`** — 🟢 as instructed, and I verified the premise: neither base directory ships a `.stories.*`, and `git ls-tree origin/develop` confirms both directories are new on this branch, so nothing was removed.

**12. `zimmProductName/index.test.tsx` is 2 tests, the thinnest of the five** — defensible (`name` is required, so there is no `undefined` case), but it is also the only atom test with no call-through or sourcing assertion. Consistent with its simplicity.

---

## ✅ Passed cleanly

- **All 374 tests pass; no skips, no `.only`, no `.todo`.** All new files execute.
- **Every component in scope has a paired `.stories.tsx`** except `product-view` / `product-detail` (nit 11). No MISSING STORY findings.
- **Story categorisation:** all 8 stories are `Commerce/` — correct per components.md's table. All 8 have a `Default` export.
- **`zimmProductContent` correctly has no test** — pure prop interpolation with zero branching, exactly testing.md's `BottomBar` exemption. Its 5 stories / 4 plays assert child counts and `rowGap`.
- **Utilities both exceed the rubric.** `richText.test.tsx` — 67 tests across all 4 exports, rejection matrix, nested same-name structure, malformed input, and `undefined`/`null`/`''`/whitespace edges. `productInfo.test.ts` — 15 tests, per-field sentinels, absent fields, `null`/`undefined` product, genuine zero price, delegated formatting. Both cover happy path **and** multiple edge cases.
- **`ZimmIcon`/Vitest known gap not applicable** — none of these components import it, so no mock needed.
- **`useIntl` provider handling is correct** — `zimmProductStyleCode` and `zimmProductMeta` both wrap renders in `IntlProvider`, per testing.md's note that `useIntl` throws without one. `zimmProductMeta:44-52` correctly wraps all five renders including the two that would pass unwrapped.
- **No `toBeTruthy()` as sole assertion in any of the seven component suites** (only `theme/index.test.tsx`, finding 5).
- **Nothing tests React-renders or React-Query-caches.** Finding 7 is the only framework-adjacent assertion.

## Could not check

- **Storybook `play` functions were not executed.** `npm run test` is `vitest run`, whose glob excludes `*.stories.tsx`. I read and assessed all 18 play functions but did not run them. They *are* CI-gated — `.github/workflows/qa.yml:385-411` builds Storybook and runs `test-storybook` (Playwright-based, plus `addon-a11y`), conditional on `detect-changes.outputs.storybook`, which this branch's story changes trigger.
- **Coverage percentages** — did not run `test:coverage`; per project memory the PWA repo has no coverage threshold, so a number would not be a gate.
- **Whether the ported base test suites would pass against the TypeScript overrides** if reinstated (finding 2) — I quantified what exists upstream but did not attempt to run them.
